name: Aota Natsu
source:
She is a close female friend of the protagonist and share a class every year. As the leader of the class, she has a dignified, seamless, and firm character.

She is the most manly girl in the class. On the other hand, she is a beginner in love. In fact, she masturbates every day thinking of the main character, or suddenly blushes and frowns.
